note: Work glossary. Seeded into D1 (table glossary) by db/glossary-seed.mjs; after that the app is the master copy (admins edit in the Glossary page). Meanings come from the SOPs and Learn modules; terms still marked [CONFIRM] stay out.

terms.meaning: The player's bonus budget. Tier 3 builds 3% of their lifetime P&L, Tier V builds 5%. Bonuses are paid out of it. Refresh it the same day before sizing any bonus.
The most a task may pay, as a share of the SW: Grace 20%, Birthday 25% (Tier 3) or 30% (Tier V), LTV 40%, Top P&L 40%, Livechat Compensation 40%.
The total valid bet amount. 1x means the player must bet the bonus once before withdrawing; 3x means three times.
Bonus amounts end in 8 (RM 38, RM 118). Take the highest one at or below your result.
The lowest and highest amount allowed. Below the floor, give the floor; never go above the max.
Giving a player two rewards for the same event or on the same day. Not allowed.
A line above which CS cannot issue alone; the ATL approves first. Examples: Birthday credit at lifetime Total Deposit RM 100,000 or more; every Livechat Compensation.
A bonus on the player's next deposit, with a validity period and 1x turnover. Risk Push reloads: 7D 10%, 14D 15%, 30D 20%, no cap.
A small cash reward on TC brands in the reload campaign. The amount is randomized, RM 8 to RM 18, for Tier 3 and Tier V.
A code for Zyra brands in the reload campaign. One claim per player per code; the player deposits RM 100 to activate it.
A step-up deposit reward that is still under testing. Nobody issues it without ATL or TL sign-off.
What you do in a complaint before any bonus: explain luck, guide to the Jackpot, guide to the current activities.
Giving a reward on the wrong platform or to the wrong tier, for example an Ang Bao on Zyra. Not allowed.
The two VIP tiers this department serves. Tier V is the higher one.
Tier 3 and Tier V players. On TC it is also the Member Label used to filter them.
Life Time Value. The LTV List uses last week's LTV in RM (LTV7) to rank the top 70 and to set the ladder bonus.

Profit and loss, counted as deposit minus withdraw. Above zero, the player is losing; below zero, the player is winning. In the BO export, Total P&L or Total Win/Loss is shown from the player's side: negative means the player lost.
Days since last deposit. It sets the risk bucket (1D, 3D, 7D, 14D, 30D) and the win-back tier.
An inactive Tier 3 or Tier V player, grouped by days since last deposit: 1D, 3D, 7D, 14D or 30D.
An inactive player, by days since last activity (1, 3, 7, 14 or 30 days).
A Tier 3 or Tier V player who did not reach their tier threshold last month and is worked through the current month (the second-month chance).
A player whose projected monthly deposit (current monthly deposit / days of data x 30) reaches the threshold. Filtered every weekend.
The monthly deposit a player needs to keep their tier. The VIP threshold mechanism sets it and it can move; read it from the list, never guess it.
A player who has just moved up into VVIP. They get a welcome Internal Mail on the day of the upgrade.
The player's lifetime total deposit. Used for the Birthday RM 100,000 ATL check.
Whether a player can get the task's bonus offer. Invalid players get IM + Push only, with no SMS and no bonus mention.
context: Valid when SW x 20% covers at least the lowest ladder bonus (Tier 3 RM 18, Tier V RM 68).
Valid when there is no LTV and no Daily P&L reward this week and the SW covers the bonus (SW x 40%).

terms.meaning: A responsible-gaming or loss-chasing flag on the player. It beats every push and offer: no push at all, route to welfare.
An abuse or fraud flag on the player. Not the same as the days-since-deposit "at risk" label. Flagged players get no bonus and no marketing.
A logged contact must come before the player's (re)deposit. No logged contact first, no credit and no reactivation count.
An inactive player who deposits again after you contacted them. It counts only if your logged contact came first; one count per player per month.
The backend system (TC or Zyra) where you check players, send mail and pushes, and export reports.
The two platforms. Each brand sits on one of them, and each has its own back office, paths and file formats.
The Lark database where task lists, tickets and the QA Record live.
The log every task ends with, usually with a BO screenshot as proof.
The shared file with the daily lists (Handover Tab) and the approved message templates (Template Tab).
Where you record who you approached and the result, per task (Top 10 P&L, TOP 20 Depositor, Telegram and others).
The sheet where you paste a BO export and sort it, for example Total P&L lowest first so the biggest losses sit on top.
Paste the numbers only, not the formulas. A normal paste breaks the Lark Base formulas.
Push upload file types. TC takes .txt, Zyra takes .csv exported from the BO. The wrong type fails the upload.
The "Reload - Angpao and Redeem code By Batch" sheet: which team runs the reload on each date, on which brands, tier and codes.
The Telegram tracker board: New, On Going Engagement, Follow Up, Successful. Move players by dragging the card.
Telegram tracker tables. The Score Table fills itself when you drag cards; never edit it. The Report Table is the only official KPI source.
Where every contact is logged with its time. It proves the contact came before the deposit.
A message to the player's inbox, sent from the BO. Often sent together with a Push notification ("IM + Push").
A notification on the player's phone. Day to day it is sent by automation; the manual way is the Fire Drill.
The manual fallback for a task that normally runs by automation. Use it only when the automation is down or being checked.
The subject and content you paste exactly, from the Template Tab or the campaign's signed-off set. Changes need approval first.
The three Zyra message languages: English, Chinese and Malay. Zyra will not create a message until all three are filled.
Who gets a mail or push: All User or a specific group. It cannot be undone after sending.
The brand search line in an SMS, for example "Cari :  LPK  777". Copy it exactly, spacing included.
The long dash. Never use it in an SMS: the vendor mis-encodes it.
Person in charge. For a player, the VIP CS who looks after them.
Greeting, real interaction and looking after the player. Relationship, not sales.
